sources.quote: Approx. 149 x 33 x 105mm (5.8 x 1.3 x 4.1 in) (width x height x depth) (excluding controllers)
will launch in limited quantities on December 3, 2018, in Japan, North America and Europe
USB port HDMI output port RESET button POWER button POWER indicator OPEN button Controller ports
a miniature games console that mirrors the look of the original PlayStation®

notes: Sony's 2018-09-19 release. Axes labelled (width x height x depth), '(excluding controllers)' — not a statement about projecting parts, so excludes_projections is null. The console mass is printed separately from the controller's 'Approx. 140g'.

controls = the instruction manual's console part names (SCPH-1000R manual PDF on playstation.com, page 1): RESET button, POWER button, POWER indicator, OPEN button. The OPEN button 'activates the switching of virtual discs and does not open the console' (manual), so it is not an eject_button and has no §3 kind; the indicator is not a control.

ports not filed: the release's Input/output row is 'HDMI™ output port', 'USB port (Micro-B)' (power input, DC 5V/1.0A from a commercially sold USB AC adaptor) and 'Controller port x 2', but Sony does not name the controller connector and §3 has no kind for the Micro-B power port, so a filed list would misstate kinds.
media: none in practice (games are preloaded), but no Sony line says 'no media drive'; media stays uncovered. external_ids: Wikidata Q56668812 ('dedicated video game console').
